study.question: Can the four feedback tasks exchange learned task representations usefully while limiting interference through the additional donor gradient path? Observed: task/action relevance macro-AUC 0.811456774 versus shared/action 0.811153943; removing action from the task scorer falls to 0.807124958. Feedback-context routing reaches 0.810578017 (entry delta -0.000878757), despite buy AUC +0.001796919; aligned routing exceeds its reversed control by 0.000319357. The incumbent shares the activation trunk and embeddings but its four task towers never exchange learned task hidden representations. None of these one-seed contrasts establishes gradient conflict.
study.hypothesis: A small receiver-conditioned transfer readout over other task tower representations can expose complementary context/target/history interactions without replacing the useful action-aware pooling. Detaching donor activations only on the additional transfer path may let receivers use donor features without their transfer losses reshaping donor task towers. This is a prospective mechanism hypothesis, not an established diagnosis. In the failed grouping family, original module construction also changed inherited initialization; preserve it here and zero-initialize added logit residual outputs to start from the incumbent function.

nearest_work.difference: Inspected pinned benchmark forward lines123-170 and blocks/aggregation/broadcast lines204-313 (git90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d). Its task-specific/shared hubs participate in repeated categorical/sequence/task aggregation and affine broadcasts. Here the incumbent stays intact; a single directed attention readout exchanges already computed tower hidden states, with a donor-path detach contrast and active self-information controls. This is not INFNet reproduction or a priority claim.

inherited_components: All incumbent embedding modules and field/source selection; no additional inputs or current labels

Separate task towers with hidden widths128/64 and four unweighted BCEs

study.proposed_difference: Extract each existing 64-wide penultimate task representation. Each receiver forms a tanh 32-wide query and attends to three tanh donor projections using scaled dot products. Project the weighted message into an additive logit residual with a zero-initialized output layer. Peer/self replacement changes source tensors while retaining donor identities and all adapters; detached/joint changes only donor activation gradient connectivity. Added modules are constructed after the incumbent reset/equalization inside a CPU RNG-restoring context. No loss hook, new labels, feedback grouping, iterative sequence passes or current target actions are introduced. Expected extra dense parameters: 4*(64*32+32) donor + 4*(64*32+32) query + 4*(32+1) output = 16,772; expected total32,077,324, subject to host measurement.
predictions: Before optimization, all four cells and a same-seed incumbent should have matching inherited state tensors, core RNG state and prediction logits because every transfer output is zero. This is a host prerequisite to check, not a completed runtime result.

If task information is useful beyond active adapter capacity, peer_detached should exceed self_detached in full-validation macro-AUC. Report every task AUC and Logloss; no task-specific veto is introduced.

If donor-path gradient ownership matters specifically for peer transfer, peer_detached should exceed peer_joint, and the difference-in-differences (peer_detached-self_detached)-(peer_joint-self_joint) should be positive in paired repetitions.

Expected added trainable dense parameter counts are identical across cells. Added attention spans only four task states and introduces no L-squared sequence work; measure training and inference cost rather than asserting equal-compute efficiency.

History-length slices are exploratory: test whether any gains occur where action/task pooling already helped (17-64 and >64 events), without requiring this for model selection. Empty-history results are uncertain given only6444 samples and 13 buy positives; retain counts and insufficient-slice flags.
falsifiers: Host initial-state or initial-prediction equality fails: attribution to transfer is invalid until corrected; retain charged failure and do not silently alter the frozen protocol.
Peer transfer does not beat active self controls: no support that other task representations add information in this implementation, even if adapters beat the incumbent.
Detached peer does not beat joint peer or the interaction is nonpositive: do not credit reduced donor-path interference; any gain can be forward exchange or generic optimization.
All new models lose to the incumbent by the fixed selection rule: retain it and report the new branch as unsuccessful regardless of an isolated buy improvement.
A repeated paired-seed contrast changes sign or user-cluster uncertainty spans zero: evidence remains inconclusive; single-seed improvement is not significance or mechanism confirmation.
alternative_explanations: Extra active nonlinear readout capacity rather than cross-task information; isolated with self donor replacements.
Detachment acts as generic gradient scaling/regularization rather than relief of task-specific conflict; examine the full2x2 interaction and avoid causal conflict claims without diagnostics.
Earlier grouping failure may be dominated by changed core initialization, optimization, or residual scale rather than useless feedback semantics; this study does not refute grouping.
A small task-row advantage with a large action-access advantage may mean shared action retrieval is sufficient; learned donor states may be redundant.
Shared donor projection parameters and shared incumbent embeddings allow other gradient paths; detached transfer is not independent per-task training.
One-pass optimization may be too short for zero-start adapters. A null only concerns this registered implementation and frozen recipe, not all task exchange methods.

Auxiliary labels reflect category/brand matching within24h and offline historical feedback visibility. Neither ad-specific conversion attribution nor production causal readiness follows from these results.
Adaptive reuse of validation and one-seed selection can exaggerate small gains; no test data or closed assessment archive is available or requested.
